name: net_hb1_borough_grounding
description: VUH-2343 targeted development check of first-visit Borough (04/09, hb09, map/battle1) Shadows. The old 04/0A control is Marketplace. Require nonempty matching native enemy counts/HP, sample native netId/actor identities and 3D positions while filming both peers, then egress. Host setup warp and native walking, two local player-default instances; not D15 two-PC real-door acceptance. Grounding additionally requires offline identity-joined height analysis and reviewed game pixels. No save writes or enemy/mission cheats.

steps.expr: all((bridge(i).get('puppet0') or {}).get('active') for i in range(2))

steps.message: Both peers must use the installed first ambient Borough battle program

steps.expr: len(enemy_hps(0))>0 and enemy_hps(0)==enemy_hps(1) and any(a['objectId']==302 and a['hp']>0 for a in enemies(1))

sample.expr: {'location':[location(i) for i in range(2)],'actors':[enemies(i) for i in range(2)],'bindings':[log_matches(r'\[statehash\] native epoch=(?P<epoch>\d+) frame=(?P<frame>\d+) netId=(?P<netId>\d+) objectId=(?P<objectId>\d+) hp=(?P<hp>-?\d+) actor=(?P<actor>[0-9A-Fa-f]+)',i)[-96:] for i in range(2)]}

steps.expr: len([s for s in saved['borough_grounding_samples'] if 'value' in s])>=10 and all(s['value']['location']==[[4,9,2,1,1,0],[4,9,2,1,1,0]] for s in saved['borough_grounding_samples'] if 'value' in s)
steps.message: Retain at least ten paired non-transition Borough observations for height analysis
